title: Vismayam 2025
summary: A sold-out night of Malayalam music and dance that became Melbourne largest Kerala community event of the year.
description: Vismayam brought a 12-piece live band, classical and cinematic dance ensembles, and full theatrical production design to a 2,400-capacity venue. Kayal Events handled artist logistics from Kochi to Melbourne, staging, ticketing strategy and a marketing campaign that sold out fourteen days before doors.

testimonial.quote: Kayal ran our biggest community night flawlessly - artists, staging, ticketing, everything. It felt like a film premiere, not a function.
testimonial.author: Anoop Krishnan
